mainEntity.name: How does AI help in survey creation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Formester’s AI generates smart questions, improves structure, and creates ready-to-use surveys based on your input.

mainEntity.name: Can I edit AI-generated survey questions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can fully customize questions, add new ones, and adjust layouts anytime.

mainEntity.name: Is Formester’s AI survey generator free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can use basic AI survey features for free. Advanced tools are available in premium plans.

mainEntity.name: Can I convert my survey into a quiz or poll?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, both. A survey turns into a scored quiz with weighted points, pass/fail thresholds, and timer support in the same editor. A survey turns into a single-question poll with one click for embedding on social or in a side-tab popover.

mainEntity.name: How do I share my AI-generated survey?

acceptedAnswer.text: You get a shareable link and embed option to distribute via email, social media, or your website.

mainEntity.name: What inputs does the AI survey generator accept?

acceptedAnswer.text: Three. A plain-text prompt (write what you need in your own words), a paste-list of questions (Formester re-orders, edits, and structures them), or a PDF brief (the AI reads the file and drafts questions from your own source material). DOCX, PowerPoint, image, and public-URL inputs are not supported today.

mainEntity.name: Which question types does the AI generate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Multiple choice, single choice, and dropdown. True/false ships as a single-choice with True and False as the two options. Open-ended, scale, rating, NPS, and date fields are added in the editor in one click.

mainEntity.name: What does the free plan actually include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unlimited forms, unlimited responses, the AI survey generator, all field types, drop-off analytics, and payment collection. Formester branding shows on free-plan surveys; brand removal starts on the Personal plan at $13/month.

mainEntity.name: How does Formester handle the data I submit to the AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Customer Data is not used to train AI models, run advertising, run marketing, or feed analytics, written into our DPA at section 4.4. The AI engine is Google Gemini, named in the same DPA's sub-processor list. We are GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant. Data moves over TLS, sits encrypted at rest, and payment data carries an additional AES-256 layer via Stripe.

mainEntity.name: How do I share an AI-generated survey?

acceptedAnswer.text: Three options. A public link (with optional password protection), a QR code (downloadable as PNG, JPEG, or SVG and color-customizable), or an embed snippet in six layouts: Standard inline, Popup, Sidebar, Side Tab, Popover, and Fullscreen. The embed works on Webflow, WordPress, Wix, Shopify, Canva, or any custom HTML.

mainEntity.name: Can I run a survey in another language?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. AI translation supports 180+ languages from a single source survey, and translations stay in sync if you edit the original. Manual translation is also supported field-by-field if you want full control over phrasing.

mainEntity.name: What integrations fire automatically on a new response?

acceptedAnswer.text: Native: HubSpot, Google Sheets, Slack, Stripe, PayPal, Calendly, n8n, Pabbly, OttoKit, GA4, GTM. Webhooks fire on Submission Created, Updated, and Deleted. Zapier covers the long tail with 1,000+ apps. Auto-fill back from Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, Excel, and most CRMs is also supported.

mainEntity.name: How accurate are AI-generated survey questions?

acceptedAnswer.text: A 2025 BMC Medical Education study found that 22% of AI-drafted single-best-answer questions were usable as-is, 47% needed minor revisions, and 31% required full rework. A separate 2025 Current Psychology study found about two-thirds of AI-generated survey items showed good psychometric properties (factor loadings above 0.40), with one-third equivalent to established human-written measures. The honest framing: AI gets you a good draft fast. The editor gets you a survey worth fielding.

mainEntity.name: Can a survey be filled offline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Respondents can complete a survey without an internet connection on the Formester offline-form mode. Responses sync automatically when the device reconnects. Useful for field research, in-store surveys, conferences, and rural data collection.

Question quality

Catch the bias before launch.

Leading, loaded, double-barrelled, absolute, and prescriptive phrasing get flagged before you send. The generator does not pretend to be perfect. The editor is where the last pass happens, with the bias warnings inline next to each suspect question.

Every draft lands in the editor before it ships. Rewrite the question, change the scale, drop the field, swap the order. The AI handles the obvious 80 percent; you spend time on the 20 percent that needs human judgment.

What the editor flags

Five bias patterns the AI catches.

  • Leading questions that nudge the respondent toward a specific answer ('Don't you agree that...').
  • Loaded questions that contain assumptions the respondent has not confirmed ('How often do you...').
  • Double-barrelled questions that ask two things at once ('Was it fast and easy?').
  • Absolute phrasing with words like 'always,' 'never,' 'every' that force a binary read.
  • Prescriptive scales where the option labels themselves carry a value judgment ('excellent / poor').

Side by side

AI survey generator vs traditional survey builder.

Both ship surveys. Only one knows the difference between a Likert scale and a leading question. Eight rows of where each one earns its keep.

Why our generator

Three things our survey generator does that a blank canvas cannot.

Create surveys instantly with an AI survey maker that generates relevant questions from your prompt, reducing manual effort.

Skips the blank-canvas tax.

Most surveys eat 90 minutes of writing time, not because the questions are hard but because choosing a starting point is. Paste your idea, get a draft, edit. The first useful question lands in under 30 seconds.

Borrows from the questions that actually work.

The generator is grounded in CSAT, NPS, eNPS, and pulse-survey patterns that earn 20 to 30% response rates in customer surveys and 76% on the average employee survey, per 2025 industry benchmarks. Use the patterns, rewrite the questions, ship the survey.

Catch the bias before launch.

Leading, double-barrel, absolute, and prescriptive phrasing get flagged before you send. The generator does not pretend to be perfect. About one third of AI-drafted survey items pass psychometric checks without edits, per a 2025 Current Psychology study, which is why every draft lands in the editor before it ships.

Who uses Formester

Built for the team that has to send the survey on Monday.

Six teams pull this generator open every week. Each one starts somewhere different. Each one ships in the same flow.

HR teams

Run quarterly engagement pulses, eNPS, exit interviews, and onboarding check-ins. Drop a job description or a values doc as the PDF and the AI keeps the language consistent across the cycle.

Employee engagement template →

Marketers

Validate positioning and messaging, run brand-awareness checks, gather post-campaign feedback. The AI rewrites questions to match your brand tone instead of sounding like a market-research vendor.

Brand awareness template →

Product managers

Test feature usefulness before you build, validate naming, find the question your roadmap already needs. Paste a PRD and the survey lands on the right respondents inside an hour.

Customer feedback template →

Customer success

NPS, CSAT, churn-risk scoring, post-resolution surveys. Conditional logic routes detractors and promoters into the right follow-up automatically.

Customer satisfaction template →

Researchers

Run market-research studies, screener surveys, and longitudinal cohort tracking. The AI helps you avoid the four most common bias traps (leading, double-barrel, absolute, and prescriptive) before you launch.

Consumer behavior template →

Educators and trainers

Course feedback, instructor evaluation, post-training assessment, end-of-term reflection. Convert the same survey into a quiz with one click when you need to score answers.

Course evaluation template →

Templates

100+ survey templates that already pass the bias check.

Every template is a real survey we have shipped or modeled on a published benchmark. Pick one, paste a prompt to localize it, send it.

Customer satisfaction (CSAT) survey → Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey → Employee engagement survey → Customer feedback survey → Brand awareness survey → Course evaluation survey →
See all 100+ survey templates →

Privacy and data

Your survey data is yours. We don't train on it.

Customer Data submitted to Formester is not used to train AI models, run advertising, run analytics, or feed marketing. That is written into our Data Processing Addendum, Section 4.4, not buried in a help article. The AI engine that drafts your questions is Google Gemini, named in our DPA's sub-processor list so you can audit it in 30 seconds.

Your account is encrypted at rest, your responses move over TLS, and payment data carries an additional AES-256 layer through Stripe. We are GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant. We are not SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA certified yet, and we say so on the security page rather than implying otherwise.

DPA §4.4 · January 2026
"Formester shall not use Customer Data for purposes of analytics, advertising, marketing, or training of artificial intelligence or machine learning models, except as strictly necessary to provide the Services."

Formester Data Processing Addendum, effective January 2026.

Read the DPA → Security overview →

Built for AI workflows

Your survey responses, ready for the AI you already use.

Every Formester survey ships with a REST API and an MCP server, so the answers do not stop at a CSV. Pipe NPS into your customer-success agent. Stream eNPS into your HR copilot. Nobody else on this list ships MCP.

MCP server

Plug Formester into Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP-compatible model.

Claude ChatGPT Custom agents

Connect Formester to any MCP-compatible model and let it read your responses directly. Ask Claude "what did detractors say last quarter?", or have a custom agent flag low-CSAT responses for the on-call account manager. The same integration powers HR copilots watching eNPS in real time.

Read the MCP docs →
REST API v2

Or build directly on the REST API.

Self-service token Org-level scope Business plan +

Pull responses into your data warehouse, push pre-filled survey URLs back from your CRM, or build a custom analytics workflow. Self-service token at app.formester.com/api in two clicks. No support ticket, no waiting.
